models.name: shopping_mall_coin_transactions
models.description:
Complete transaction history for digital coin movements including earning, spending, refunds, and administrative adjustments.

The transaction system maintains immutable records of all coin movements within the marketplace ecosystem. Every coin creation or destruction event is logged with detailed context including the transaction type, participating parties, business reason, and precise timestamp for comprehensive audit trail.

Transactions support various earning mechanisms including purchase rewards, promotional campaigns, referral bonuses, and manual adjustments while maintaining strict accounting integrity. The system ensures balance reconciliation through atomic transaction processing and provides detailed analytics for customer behavior analysis and loyalty program optimization.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_coin_id
foreignFields.description: Associated coin wallet for the transaction. {@link shopping_mall_coins.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer involved in the transaction (for earning or spending). {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller involved in the transaction (for rewarding or receiving). {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}

plainFields.name: transaction_type
plainFields.description: Type of coin transaction: "earning" (coins received), "spending" (coins used), "refund" (coins returned), "adjustment" (administrative changes), "expiry" (expired coins), or "conversion" (mileage to coins conversion). Supports comprehensive transaction categorization for loyalty program analytics.

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Coin amount for the transaction. Positive for earning, negative for spending/refunds. Supports fractional amounts for precise loyalty calculations while maintaining audit trail integrity.

plainFields.name: previous_balance
plainFields.description: Wallet balance before the transaction. Enables balance verification and audit trail reconstruction in case of system issues or dispute resolution.

plainFields.name: new_balance
plainFields.description: Wallet balance after the transaction. Must equal previous_balance + amount for accounting integrity verification and balance reconciliation processes.

plainFields.name: reference_type
plainFields.description: References the business context: "order" (purchase-related), "promotion" (campaign-related), "referral" (referral bonus), "manual" (administrative), "expiry" (automatic expiration), or "conversion" (currency conversion). Provides context for transaction analytics and reporting.

plainFields.name: reference_id
plainFields.description: ID reference to the related business entity. Links to orders, promotions, referrals, or other relevant entities based on reference_type for complete transaction context and audit trail maintenance.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of the transaction reason. Provides human-readable context for customer service, dispute resolution, and loyalty program understanding of transaction purposes.

plainFields.name: transaction_date
plainFields.description: Date and time when the transaction was recorded. Maintains precise chronological ordering for audit trail integrity and customer transaction history reporting.

plainFields.name: effective_date
plainFields.description: Date when the transaction takes effect (may differ from transaction_date for batch processing). Supports backdated transactions and end-of-period processing requirements.

plainFields.name: expiry_date
plainFields.description: Date when earned coins expire (applicable for promotional or bonus coins). Enables time-limited loyalty rewards and automatic coin expiry processing for promotional funds.

plainFields.name: source_description
plainFields.description: Source system or process that initiated the transaction. Tracks automatic processes, user actions, administrative overrides, or system integrations for complete audit trail maintenance.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address of the device used for the transaction. Provides additional security context for fraud detection analytics and geographic transaction pattern analysis.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: Browser or app user agent for transaction source tracking. Helps identify device types and geographic patterns for security analytics and customer behavior analysis.

plainFields.name: is_reversible
plainFields.description: Whether this transaction can be reversed or modified. False for final transactions (spending, expiry), true for reversible transactions requiring future adjustments or corrections.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp for database operation tracking and historical audit trail maintenance within the transaction logging system.

models.name: shopping_mall_mileages
models.description:
Digital mileage points system for loyalty program management including earning, redemption, and expiration tracking.

The mileage system provides a complete loyalty points framework separate from the coin system, focusing on purchase-based rewards, tier progression, and redemption for premium rewards. Mileage points operate as a separate currency with different earning rates, redemption schedules, and business rules compared to coins.

The system supports tiered loyalty programs with escalating benefits, automatic mileage expiry processing, detailed redemption history tracking, and comprehensive analytics for customer engagement monitoring. Mileage tracking enables sophisticated loyalty program mechanics including upgrade pathways, bonus point campaigns, and targeted promotional offers based on customer activity patterns.

plainFields.name: total_mileage
plainFields.description: Total lifetime mileage points earned. Tracks cumulative loyalty point accumulation for tier eligibility calculations and long-term customer engagement analytics.

plainFields.name: available_mileage
plainFields.description: Current available mileage balance for redemption. Deducts already-redeemed points and expired points to show actual redeemable balance for customer benefit calculations.

plainFields.name: redeemed_mileage
plainFields.description: Lifetime mileage points that have been redeemed. Tracks customer reward engagement and redemption patterns for loyalty program effectiveness analysis.

plainFields.name: expired_mileage
plainFields.description: Mileage points that have expired due to inactivity. Enables automatic expiry processing and provides transparency about loyalty point lifecycle management.

plainFields.name: member_tier
plainFields.description: Current loyalty tier: "bronze", "silver", "gold", or "platinum". Determines benefit levels including earning multipliers, special offers, and service privileges based on point accumulation and activity patterns.

plainFields.name: tier_start_date
plainFields.description: Date when current tier level was achieved. Used for tier anniversary rewards, upgrade pathway calculations, and loyalty program progression tracking.

plainFields.name: mystery_points
plainFields.description: Bonus mileage points for surprise rewards or promotional campaigns. Enables flexible loyalty program mechanics and targeted engagement campaigns with customer delight features.

plainFields.name: last_activity_date
plainFields.description: Date of most recent mileage-related activity. Used for activity-based promotions, engagement monitoring, and automatic account maintenance for inactive accounts.

plainFields.name: next_expiry_date
plainFields.description: Date when points will expire if not used. Provides customer transparency about mileage validity and enables proactive redemption campaigns before expiration dates.

plainFields.name: birthday_bonus_applied
plainFields.description: Whether the customer received mileage bonus for their birthday this year. Prevents duplicate birthday rewards and tracks personalized celebration benefits in loyalty program.

plainFields.name: referral_bonus_available
plainFields.description: Whether the customer has unused referral bonus credit available. Enables tracking of friend referral benefits and encourages social sharing for loyalty program growth.

plainFields.name: special_tier_eligible
plainFields.description: Whether the customer is eligible for special tier upgrades. Indicates VIP status or special consideration for targeted loyalty benefits beyond standard tier progression.

plainFields.name: miles_coalition_member
plainFields.description: Whether the customer participates in partner airline or coalition mileage programs. Enables broader loyalty ecosystem integration and cross-platform benefit coordination.

plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp for account age tracking and loyalty program analytics including member acquisition trends and retention analysis.

plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp for activity tracking and concurrency control within the loyalty points management system with real-time balance updates.
